Name: CP-Where-Winds-Meet Sect UI
Author: Yvbie
Description:
每个门派已分文件夹，喜欢哪个用哪个。
点开对应文件夹将所需拉入Mods即可。

目前有四个门派，三更天，九流门，梨园和天泉，其他门派会画的。

如果你有mod管理器（尾号10455）可以直接把整个文件夹放入Mods，根据所需勾选即可。
但我不知道除了10455之外的mod管理器可不可以，或许你可以试试。

感谢喜欢和使用！
All factions are sorted into separate folders—use whichever you prefer.
Open the corresponding folder and drag the required files into Mods.
More factions will be added later.
If you use Mod Manager (ID: 10455), you can directly place the entire folder into Mods and enable as needed.
I'm not sure about other mod managers, but you can try.
Thank you for your support and enjoy!
Here are the translation options for the four factions:
Literal Translation 
三更天 → "Sangeng Tian" (Red，flower)
九流门 → "Jiuliumen" (Green，mouse)
梨园 → "Liyuan" (Yellow，deer)
天泉 → "Tianquan" (Blue)


————8.8——————
更新新的四个门派：青溪、孤云、醉花阴、狂澜
前面四个门派的文字部分底图也修改为对应颜色。

后续打算画燕云其他名片的对话框。

Added four new factions: 
青溪 → "Qingxi" （Green, Apricot Blossom）
孤云→ "GuYun" （Purple, Star, Astrolabe）
醉花阴 → "ZuiHuaYIn" （Green, Flower, Peacock Feather）
狂澜 → "KuangLan" （Red, Gourd）

The text backgrounds for these four factions have been updated with their respective theme colors.

Future plans include designing dialogue boxes for other YanYun faction business cards.
